title: OAuth consent must be visible in the actual Side Panel workflow
summary: The settings page clears the pairing-token input after configuration and is not the OAuth consent UI. Pending connection requests must surface directly in the Observer Side Panel.
claims: An empty pairing-token input does not imply an unpaired extension.
Consent cards are rendered in the main Chrome Side Panel when pending.
decision: Surface Connection request / Allow / Deny directly in Observer Side Panel.
rationale: The toolbar-popup-only consent path was invisible in the user's normal workflow.

evidence.ref: Chrome Observer surfaces MCP connection consent in the main side panel
